method.frame: UTF-8 bytes of the serialized JSON-RPC tools/list response the server transmits, excluding the trailing newline
token_estimates: estimated_tokens_by_four_bytes = ceil(bytes / 4); heuristic, not a tokenizer
estimated_tokens_structural = count of identifier/punctuation runs after splitting camelCase; heuristic, not a tokenizer
method.server: dist/server/createServer.js over the SDK in-memory transport (production composition)
